evidence.detail: The /discord/ route is a bare redirect to discord.gg — no widget, no JSON, no embed
No discord widget implementation exists anywhere in decksite templates or views
Three approaches discussed (native Discord iframe embed, react-discord-widget library, custom widget.json rendering) with no consensus reached

triage.notes: Owner and contributor discussed three different implementation styles in comments without reaching a decision. The feature hasn't moved in years; owner needs to decide whether this is still wanted and which approach to take.
